slides.headline: Do not keep all your eggs in one basket
slides.subhead: Asset allocation is simply how you divide your money.

points.title: Different assets
points.text: Equity, debt and gold each behave differently over time.

points.title: Match your goals
points.text: Longer goals can hold more risk than shorter ones.

points.title: Revisit yearly
points.text: Life changes, so check your split once a year.

slides.headline: Divide wisely. Review yearly.
slides.cta: Save this for your yearly review
slides.footnote: General education, not advice for any individual.

caption: Asset allocation means deciding how to divide your money between different kinds of investments. It depends on your goals and how soon you need the money. Review it once a year. #AssetAllocation #MutualFunds #PersonalFinance #India #InvestingBasics
